# cool-web-fx

> A static gallery of cool web interaction effects, each recreated as a single
> self-contained, copy-pasteable HTML/CSS/JS file. Generated with Claude Code.
> Inspired by reactbits.dev.

Each effect's full source lives at /effects/<slug>.html and is also printed
verbatim in each demo page's HTML for easy scraping (no JS execution needed).

## Read first

- [Agent skill file](/skill.md): how to grab and reuse an effect, and attribution.

## Effects

- cyber-canvas: matrix glyph field with rippling rainbow waves (Canvas 2D) — seen on https://chatgpt.com/cyber — /effects/cyber-canvas.html
- meshy-grid: skewed grid + lime light bloom + flowing-gradient CTA (CSS/SVG) — seen on https://www.meshy.ai/ — /effects/meshy-grid.html
- midjourney-home: prompt-text vortex with a CRT post-process WebGL shader — seen on https://www.midjourney.com/home — /effects/midjourney-home.html
- sneakers-text: gibberish-to-readable cipher decode, DOM text in monospace — seen on https://infisical.com/ — /effects/sneakers-text.html
- electron-lines: glowing pulses along SVG paths — seen on https://schematichq.com/ and https://portkey.ai/ — /effects/electron-lines.html
- text-vortex: particles swirling into text, an original effect (not site-specific) — /effects/text-vortex.html
- resend-cube: all-black material-varied Rubik's cube (Three.js via CDN) — seen on https://resend.com/home — /effects/resend-cube.html
- resend-rainbow-button: pill with a spinning rainbow gradient border (@property --angle) — seen on https://resend.com/home — /effects/resend-rainbow-button.html
- resend-conic-border: card with a sweeping conic-gradient border — seen on https://resend.com/home — /effects/resend-conic-border.html
- coderabbit-dither: extruded glyph raymarched into vertical-line ASCII bars (WebGL2 SDF + glyph dither) — seen on https://app.coderabbit.ai/login — /effects/coderabbit-dither.html
